title: The Ask test set runs its three-clip video case again
goal: One of the five video requests in the Ask test set (title pages before each of three clips) has not run since 2026-10-24: its setup never finds the open recording, so it cannot lay the two extra copies, and every video score since leaves it out.
notes: Reproduced twice on 2026-11-13 (commit e478f6063): Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases video-case-titles-before-three-clips,... printed "--> video-case-titles-before-three-clips: ... not run: the sample recording never opened", and --resume 20261113-041650-ask printed the same. The message comes from prepare() in Scripts/ask-eval/engines.mjs: for 150 s the bridge list_documents found no document with kind video and a file. The walk then sat on waitFor clipsOfOneRecording 3 until 540 s ran out. Last scored run: 20261024-160940-ask (85.6). Other video cases read results over the same bridge fine, so suspect what list_documents says about the sample (file missing?) or the bridge start while the walk is in its setup, not Ask.
acceptance: Scripts/ask-eval.sh run --engine ask --cases video-case-titles-before-three-clips runs the case and scores it
The case starts with three clips of the sample recording on the timeline
